fusions.name: Quiver That Hums
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each one deals 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Nailed to the Spot
fusions.desc: Hits a target up to 9 tiles away: it deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Longer Reach
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When you go a while without landing a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
